scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @weather/shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @weather/shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm test -w @weather/shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w client
